CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly bound to a processing/origin label (command_estimate) for the same candidate referent.

COD.rationale: The report identifies content (red positions), states organization/access (origin/completed_record) for the same referent/time, and separates content vs status.

A.rationale: Origin/processing labels (command_estimate, native_conditional_record) are explicitly tied to specific candidate content origins, linking processing/attention conditions to content access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify represented content (colour-labeled position sets) and their attributes.

D.rationale: Content entries are presented alongside separate origin/status metadata for the same referents, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: The text states display orientation and provides explicit origin/organization metadata describing how content is presented and sourced.
